verdict.rationale: Convex's CLI and MCP server run headlessly and can push schema/function changes from a script (convex-probe-6, convex-probe-7, convex-docs-6/17), and Convex explicitly promotes agent-driven project creation (convex-docs-20, convex-docs-23). However, auth setup relies on integrating third-party providers (Clerk, WorkOS, Auth0) or the Convex Auth library, which typically requires dashboard/config steps not shown to be fully scriptable via CLI, and Convex has no first-class 'policies' construct (authorization is just custom code), so a fully headless schema+auth+policy bootstrap isn't demonstrated end-to-end.
